46039.subject: Mathematics
46039.question_text: If 23<sub>x</sub> + 101<sub>x</sub> = 130<sub>x</sub>, find the value of x
46039.explanation:
23x + 101x = 130x

2 x X1 + 3 x Xo + 1 x X2 + 0 x X1 + 1 x Xo

= 1 x Xo = 1 x X2 + 3 x X1 + 0 x Xo

= X2 + 3x + 0

2x + 3 = x2 + 0 + 1 + x2 + 3x

2x - 3x + x2 - x2 = -3 - 1

- x = -4

x = 4

46046.subject: Mathematics
46046.explanation:
Note that \(\frac{10\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}} = \frac{10\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}} \times - \frac{\sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{5}}\)

= \(\frac{10\sqrt{15}}{\sqrt{5}} = 2\sqrt{15}\)

hence, (\(\frac{10\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{5}} - \sqrt{15}\))2 = (\(2\sqrt{15} - \sqrt{15}\))2

= (\(2\sqrt{15} - \sqrt{15}\))(\(2\sqrt{15} - \sqrt{15}\))

= 4 x 15 - 2 x 15 - 2 x 15 + 15

= 15

46056.question_text: The distance, d, through which a stone falls from rest varies directly as the square of the time, t, taken. If the stone falls 45cm in 3 seconds, how far will it fall in 6 seconds?
46056.explanation:
d \(\alpha\) t2

d = t2 k

where k is a constant. d = 45cm, when t = 3s; thus 45 = 32 x t

k = \(\frac{45}{9}\) = 5

thus equation connecting d and t is d = 5t2

when t = 6s, d = 5 x 62

= 5 x 36

= 180cm

Factorize the denominator;

Y2 + 7y - 3y - 21

= y(y + 7) -3 (y + 7)

= (y - 3)(y + 7)

Hence the expression \(\frac{y^2 - 9y + 18}{y^2 + 4y - 21}\) is undefined

From the table above, event space, n(E) = 6

sample space, n(S) = 36

\(\frac{n(E)}{n(S)}\)

= \(\frac{6}{36}\)

= \(\frac{1}{6}\)
